class.name: UPnPAction
class.description:
A UPnP action.
Each UPnP service contains zero or more actions. Each action may have zero or more UPnP state variables as arguments.
class.author: @author $Id: 848664758445d1510264b23edc70abf71d6439ed $

method.name: getName
method.lead: Returns the action name.
method.description:
Returns the action name.
The action name corresponds to the {@code name} field in the {@code actionList} of the service description.
For standard actions defined by a UPnP Forum working committee, action names must not begin with {@code X_ } nor {@code A_}.
For non-standard actions specified by a UPnP vendor and added to a standard service, action names must begin with {@code X_}.
This method must continue to return the action name after the UPnP action has been removed from the network.
method.return: Name of action, must not contain a hyphen character or a hash character

method.name: getReturnArgumentName
method.lead: Returns the name of the designated return argument.
method.description:
Returns the name of the designated return argument.
One of the output arguments can be flagged as a designated return argument.
This method must continue to return the action return argument name after the UPnP action has been removed from the network.
method.return: The name of the designated return argument or {@code null} if none is marked.

method.name: getInputArgumentNames
method.lead: Lists all input arguments for this action.
method.description:
Lists all input arguments for this action.
Each action may have zero or more input arguments.
This method must continue to return the action input argument names after the UPnP action has been removed from the network.
method.return: Array of input argument names or {@code null} if no input arguments.

method.name: getOutputArgumentNames
method.lead: List all output arguments for this action.
method.description:
List all output arguments for this action.
This method must continue to return the action output argument names after the UPnP action has been removed from the network.
method.return: Array of output argument names or {@code null} if there are no output arguments.

method.name: getStateVariable
method.lead: Finds the state variable associated with an argument name.
method.description:
Finds the state variable associated with an argument name.
Helps to resolve the association of state variables with argument names in UPnP actions.
method.param: The name of the UPnP action argument.
method.return: State variable associated with the named argument or {@code null} if there is no such argument.
method.throws: if the UPnP action has been removed from the network.

method.name: invoke
method.lead: Invokes the action.
method.description:
Invokes the action.
The input and output arguments are both passed as {@code Dictionary} objects. Each entry in the {@code Dictionary} object has a {@code String} object as key representing the argument name and the value is the argument itself. The class of an argument value must be assignable from the class of the associated UPnP state variable.
The input argument {@code Dictionary} object must contain exactly those arguments listed by {@code getInputArguments} method. The output argument {@code Dictionary} object will contain exactly those arguments listed by {@code getOutputArguments} method.
method.param: A {@code Dictionary} of arguments. Must contain the correct set and type of arguments for this action. May be {@code null} if no input arguments exist.
method.return: A {@code Dictionary} with the output arguments. {@code null} if the action has no output arguments.
method.throws: if the UPnP action has been removed from the network.
The execution fails for some reason.

class.name: UPnPDevice
class.description:
Represents a UPnP device.
For each UPnP root and embedded device, an object is registered with the framework under the {@code UPnPDevice} interface.
The relationship between a root device and its embedded devices can be deduced using the {@code UPnPDevice.CHILDREN_UDN} and {@code UPnPDevice.PARENT_UDN} service registration properties.
The values of the UPnP property names are defined by the UPnP Forum.
All values of the UPnP properties are obtained from the device using the device's default locale.
If an application wants to query for a set of localized property values, it has to use the method {@code UPnPDevice.getDescriptions(String locale)}.
class.author: @author $Id: 2d6f1cc601a87117fef337d55e7fe2f8ee887b77 $

method.name: getService
method.lead: Locates a specific service by its service id.
method.description: Locates a specific service by its service id.
method.return: The requested service or null if not found.
method.throws: if the UPnP device has been removed from the network.

method.name: getServices
method.lead: Lists all services provided by this device.
method.description: Lists all services provided by this device.
method.return: Array of services or {@code null} if no services are available.
method.throws: if the UPnP device has been removed from the network.

method.name: getIcons
method.lead: Lists all icons for this device in a given locale.
method.description:
Lists all icons for this device in a given locale.
The UPnP specification allows a device to present different icons based on the client's locale.
method.param: A language tag as defined by RFC 1766 and maintained by ISO 639. Examples include "{@code de}", "{@code en}" or " {@code en-US}". The default locale of the device is specified by passing a {@code null} argument.
method.return: Array of icons or null if no icons are available.
method.throws: if the UPnP device has been removed from the network.

method.name: getDescriptions
method.lead: Get a set of localized UPnP properties.
method.description:
Get a set of localized UPnP properties.
The UPnP specification allows a device to present different device properties based on the client's locale. The properties used to register the UPnPDevice service in the OSGi registry are based on the device's default locale. To obtain a localized set of the properties, an application can use this method.
Not all properties might be available in all locales. This method does not substitute missing properties with their default locale versions.
This method must continue to return the properties after the UPnP device has been removed from the network.
method.param: A language tag as defined by RFC 1766 and maintained by ISO 639. Examples include "{@code de}", "{@code en}" or " {@code en-US}". The default locale of the device is specified by passing a {@code null} argument.
method.return: Dictionary mapping property name Strings to property value Strings

field.name: UPNP_EXPORT
field.lead: The {@code UPnP.export} service property is a hint that marks a device to be picked up and exported by the UPnP Service.
field.description:
The {@code UPnP.export} service property is a hint that marks a device to be picked up and exported by the UPnP Service. Imported devices do not have this property set. The registered property requires no value.
The UPNP_EXPORT string is "UPnP.export".

field.name: UDN
field.lead: Property key for the Unique Device Name (UDN) property.
field.description: Property key for the Unique Device Name (UDN) property. It is the unique identifier of an instance of a {@code UPnPDevice}. The value of the property is a {@code String} object of the Device UDN. Value of the key is "UPnP.device.UDN". This property must be set.

field.name: ID
field.lead: Property key for the Unique Device ID property.
field.description: Property key for the Unique Device ID property. This property is an alias to {@code UPnPDevice.UDN}. It is merely provided for reasons of symmetry with the {@code UPnPService.ID} property. The value of the property is a {@code String} object of the Device UDN. The value of the key is "UPnP.device.UDN".

field.name: TYPE
field.lead: Property key for the UPnP Device Type property.
field.description:
Property key for the UPnP Device Type property. Some standard property values are defined by the Universal Plug and Play Forum. The type string also includes a version number as defined in the UPnP specification. This property must be set.
For standard devices defined by a UPnP Forum working committee, this must consist of the following components in the given order separated by colons:
{@code urn}
schemas-upnp-org
{@code device}
a device type suffix
an integer device version
For non-standard devices specified by UPnP vendors following components must be specified in the given order separated by colons:
{@code urn}
an ICANN domain name owned by the vendor
{@code device}
a device type suffix
an integer device version
To allow for backward compatibility the UPnP driver must automatically generate additional Device Type property entries for smaller versions than the current one. If for example a device announces its type as version 3, then properties for versions 2 and 1 must be automatically generated.
In the case of exporting a UPnPDevice, the highest available version must be announced on the network.
Syntax Example: {@code urn:schemas-upnp-org:device:deviceType:v}
The value is "UPnP.device.type".

field.name: MANUFACTURER
field.lead: Mandatory property key for the device manufacturer's property.
field.description: Mandatory property key for the device manufacturer's property. The property value holds a String representation of the device manufacturer's name. Value is "UPnP.device.manufacturer".

field.name: MODEL_NAME
field.lead: Mandatory property key for the device model name.
field.description: Mandatory property key for the device model name. The property value holds a {@code String} object giving more information about the device model. Value is "UPnP.device.modelName".

field.name: FRIENDLY_NAME
field.lead: Mandatory property key for a short user friendly version of the device name.
field.description: Mandatory property key for a short user friendly version of the device name. The property value holds a {@code String} object with the user friendly name of the device. Value is "UPnP.device.friendlyName".

field.name: MANUFACTURER_URL
field.lead: Optional property key for a URL to the device manufacturers Web site.
field.description: Optional property key for a URL to the device manufacturers Web site. The value of the property is a {@code String} object representing the URL. Value is "UPnP.device.manufacturerURL".

field.name: MODEL_DESCRIPTION
field.lead: Optional (but recommended) property key for a {@code String} object with a long description of the device for the end user.
field.description: Optional (but recommended) property key for a {@code String} object with a long description of the device for the end user. The value is "UPnP.device.modelDescription".

field.name: MODEL_NUMBER
field.lead: Optional (but recommended) property key for a {@code String} class typed property holding the model number of the device.
field.description: Optional (but recommended) property key for a {@code String} class typed property holding the model number of the device. Value is "UPnP.device.modelNumber".

field.name: MODEL_URL
field.lead: Optional property key for a {@code String} typed property holding a string representing the URL to the Web site for this model.
field.description: Optional property key for a {@code String} typed property holding a string representing the URL to the Web site for this model. Value is "UPnP.device.modelURL".

field.name: SERIAL_NUMBER
field.lead: Optional (but recommended) property key for a {@code String} typed property holding the serial number of the device.
field.description: Optional (but recommended) property key for a {@code String} typed property holding the serial number of the device. Value is "UPnP.device.serialNumber".

field.name: UPC
field.lead: Optional property key for a {@code String} typed property holding the Universal Product Code (UPC) of the device.
field.description: Optional property key for a {@code String} typed property holding the Universal Product Code (UPC) of the device. Value is "UPnP.device.UPC".

field.name: PRESENTATION_URL
field.lead: Optional (but recommended) property key for a {@code String} typed property holding a string representing the URL to a device representation Web page.
field.description: Optional (but recommended) property key for a {@code String} typed property holding a string representing the URL to a device representation Web page. Value is "UPnP.presentationURL".

field.name: PARENT_UDN
field.lead: The property key that must be set for all embedded devices.
field.description: The property key that must be set for all embedded devices. It contains the UDN of the parent device. The property is not set for root devices. The value is "UPnP.device.parentUDN".

field.name: CHILDREN_UDN
field.lead: The property key that must be set for all devices containing other embedded devices.
field.description:
The property key that must be set for all devices containing other embedded devices.
The value is an array of UDNs for each of the device's children ( {@code String[]}). The array contains UDNs for the immediate descendants only.
If an embedded device in turn contains embedded devices, the latter are not included in the array.
The UPnP Specification does not encourage more than two levels of nesting.
The property is not set if the device does not contain embedded devices.
The property is of type {@code String[]}. Value is "UPnP.device.childrenUDN"

class.name: UPnPEventListener
class.lead: UPnP Events are mapped and delivered to applications according to the OSGi whiteboard model.
class.description:
UPnP Events are mapped and delivered to applications according to the OSGi whiteboard model. An application that wishes to be notified of events generated by a particular UPnP Device registers a service extending this interface.
The notification call from the UPnP Service to any {@code UPnPEventListener} object must be done asynchronous with respect to the originator (in a separate thread).
Upon registration of the UPnP Event Listener service with the Framework, the service is notified for each variable which it listens for with an initial event containing the current value of the variable. Subsequent notifications only happen on changes of the value of the variable.
A UPnP Event Listener service filter the events it receives. This event set is limited using a standard framework filter expression which is specified when the listener service is registered.
The filter is specified in a property named "upnp.filter" and has as a value an object of type {@code org.osgi.framework.Filter}.
When the Filter is evaluated, the following keywords are recognized as defined as literal constants in the {@code UPnPDevice} class.
The valid subset of properties for the registration of UPnP Event Listener services are:
{@code UPnPDevice.TYPE}-- Which type of device to listen for events.
{@code UPnPDevice.ID}-- The ID of a specific device to listen for events.
{@code UPnPService.TYPE}-- The type of a specific service to listen for events.
{@code UPnPService.ID}-- The ID of a specific service to listen for events.
class.author: @author $Id: 52c82582004ef228e212b4dbd9aeb57d98e5e260 $

method.name: notifyUPnPEvent
method.lead: Callback method that is invoked for received events.
method.description:
Callback method that is invoked for received events.
The events are collected in a {@code Dictionary} object. Each entry has a {@code String} key representing the event name (= state variable name) and the new value of the state variable. The class of the value object must match the class specified by the UPnP State Variable associated with the event. This method must be called asynchronously
method.param: ID of the device sending the events
ID of the service sending the events
{@code Dictionary} object containing the new values for the state variables that have changed.

field.description: Key for a service property having a value that is an object of type {@code org.osgi.framework.Filter} and that is used to limit received events.

class.name: UPnPIcon
class.description:
A UPnP icon representation.
Each UPnP device can contain zero or more icons.
class.author: @author $Id: f654c000befa98e61d28be8be5e904fb4dab1b81 $

method.name: getMimeType
method.lead: Returns the MIME type of the icon.
method.description:
Returns the MIME type of the icon.
This method returns the format in which the icon graphics, read from the {@code InputStream} object obtained by the {@code getInputStream()} method, is encoded.
The format of the returned string is in accordance to RFC2046. A list of valid MIME types is maintained by the IANA.
Typical values returned include: "image/jpeg" or "image/gif"
This method must continue to return the icon MIME type after the UPnP device has been removed from the network.
method.return: The MIME type of the encoded icon.

method.name: getWidth
method.lead: Returns the width of the icon in pixels.
method.description:
Returns the width of the icon in pixels.
If the actual width of the icon is unknown, -1 is returned.
This method must continue to return the icon width after the UPnP device has been removed from the network.
method.return: The width in pixels, or -1 if unknown.

method.name: getHeight
method.lead: Returns the height of the icon in pixels.
method.description:
Returns the height of the icon in pixels.
If the actual height of the icon is unknown, -1 is returned.
This method must continue to return the icon height after the UPnP device has been removed from the network.
method.return: The height in pixels, or -1 if unknown.

method.name: getSize
method.lead: Returns the size of the icon in bytes.
method.description:
Returns the size of the icon in bytes.
This method returns the number of bytes of the icon available to read from the {@code InputStream} object obtained by the {@code getInputStream()} method. If the actual size can not be determined, -1 is returned.
method.return: The icon size in bytes, or -1 if the size is unknown.
method.throws: if the UPnP device has been removed from the network.

method.name: getDepth
method.lead: Returns the color depth of the icon in bits.
method.description:
Returns the color depth of the icon in bits.
This method must continue to return the icon depth after the UPnP device has been removed from the network.
method.return: The color depth in bits. If the actual color depth of the icon is unknown, -1 is returned.

method.name: getInputStream
method.lead: Returns an {@code InputStream} object for the icon data.
method.description:
Returns an {@code InputStream} object for the icon data.
The {@code InputStream} object provides a way for a client to read the actual icon graphics data. The number of bytes available from this {@code InputStream} object can be determined via the {@code getSize()} method. The format of the data encoded can be determined by the MIME type available via the {@code getMimeType()} method.
method.return: An InputStream to read the icon graphics data from.
method.throws: If the {@code InputStream} cannot be returned.
if the UPnP device has been removed from the network.

class.name: UPnPService
class.lead: A representation of a UPnP Service.
class.description:
A representation of a UPnP Service.
Each UPnP device contains zero or more services. The UPnP description for a service defines actions, their arguments, and event characteristics.
class.author: @author $Id: 8a430d12a3100d60e2b736da1241be735aee480e $

method.name: getId
method.lead: Returns the {@code serviceId} field in the UPnP service description.
method.description:
Returns the {@code serviceId} field in the UPnP service description.
For standard services defined by a UPnP Forum working committee, the serviceId must contain the following components in the indicated order:
{@code urn:upnp-org:serviceId:}
service ID suffix
Example: {@code urn:upnp-org:serviceId:serviceID}.
Note that {@code upnp-org} is used instead of {@code schemas-upnp-org} in this example because an XML schema is not defined for each serviceId.
For non-standard services specified by UPnP vendors, the serviceId must contain the following components in the indicated order:
{@code urn:}
ICANN domain name owned by the vendor
{@code :serviceId:}
service ID suffix
Example: {@code urn:domain-name:serviceId:serviceID}.
This method must continue to return the service id after the UPnP service has been removed from the network.
method.return: The service ID suffix defined by a UPnP Forum working committee or specified by a UPnP vendor. Must be <= 64 characters. Single URI.

method.name: getType
method.lead: Returns the {@code serviceType} field in the UPnP service description.
method.description:
Returns the {@code serviceType} field in the UPnP service description.
For standard services defined by a UPnP Forum working committee, the serviceType must contain the following components in the indicated order:
{@code urn:schemas-upnp-org:service:}
service type suffix:
integer service version
Example: {@code urn:schemas-upnp-org:service:serviceType:v}.
For non-standard services specified by UPnP vendors, the {@code serviceType} must contain the following components in the indicated order:
{@code urn:}
ICANN domain name owned by the vendor
{@code :service:}
service type suffix:
integer service version
Example: {@code urn:domain-name:service:serviceType:v}.
This method must continue to return the service type after the UPnP service has been removed from the network.
method.return: The service type suffix defined by a UPnP Forum working committee or specified by a UPnP vendor. Must be <= 64 characters, not including the version suffix and separating colon. Single URI.

method.name: getVersion
method.lead: Returns the version suffix encoded in the {@code serviceType} field in the UPnP service description.
method.description:
Returns the version suffix encoded in the {@code serviceType} field in the UPnP service description.
This method must continue to return the service version after the UPnP service has been removed from the network.
method.return: The integer service version defined by a UPnP Forum working committee or specified by a UPnP vendor.

field.name: TYPE
field.lead: Property key for the optional service type uri.
field.description:
Property key for the optional service type uri.
The service type property is used when registering UPnP Device services and UPnP Event Listener services. The property contains a {@code String} array ({@code String[]}) of service types. A UPnP Device service can thus announce what types of services it contains. A UPnP Event Listener service can announce for what type of UPnP services it wants notifications. The service version is encoded in the type string as specified in the UPnP specification. A {@code null} value is a wildcard, matching all service types. Value is "UPnP.service.type".

field.name: ID
field.lead: Property key for the optional service id.
field.description:
Property key for the optional service id.
The service id property is used when registering UPnP Device services or UPnP Event Listener services. The value of the property contains a {@code String} array ({@code String[]}) of service ids. A UPnP Device service can thus announce what service ids it contains. A UPnP Event Listener service can announce for what UPnP service ids it wants notifications. A service id does not have to be universally unique. It must be unique only within a device. A {@code null} value is a wildcard, matching all services. The value is "UPnP.service.id".

class.name: UPnPStateVariable
class.lead: The meta-information of a UPnP state variable as declared in the device's service state table (SST).
class.description:
The meta-information of a UPnP state variable as declared in the device's service state table (SST).
Method calls to interact with a device (e.g. {@code UPnPAction.invoke(...);}) use this class to encapsulate meta information about the input and output arguments.
The actual values of the arguments are passed as Java objects. The mapping of types from UPnP data types to Java data types is described with the field definitions.
class.author: @author $Id: c3cb5d64cc98036befd19526c5a5855b1368b217 $

method.lead: Returns the variable name.
method.description:
Returns the variable name.
All standard variables defined by a UPnP Forum working committee must not begin with {@code X_} nor {@code A_}.
All non-standard variables specified by a UPnP vendor and added to a standard service must begin with {@code X_}.
This method must continue to return the state variable name after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.
method.return: Name of state variable. Must not contain a hyphen character nor a hash character. Should be < 32 characters.

method.name: getJavaDataType
method.lead: Returns the Java class associated with the UPnP data type of this state variable.
method.description:
Returns the Java class associated with the UPnP data type of this state variable.
Mapping between the UPnP data types and Java classes is performed according to the schema mentioned above.
Integer ui1, ui2, i1, i2, i4, int
Long ui4, time, time.tz
Float r4, float
Double r8, number, fixed.14.4
Character char
String string, uri, uuid
Date date, dateTime, dateTime.tz
Boolean boolean
byte[] bin.base64, bin.hex
This method must continue to return the state variable java type after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.
method.return: A class object corresponding to the Java type of this argument.

method.name: getUPnPDataType
method.lead: Returns the UPnP type of this state variable.
method.description:
Returns the UPnP type of this state variable. Valid types are defined as constants.
This method must continue to return the state variable UPnP data type after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.
method.return: The UPnP data type of this state variable, as defined in above constants.

method.name: getDefaultValue
method.lead: Returns the default value, if defined.
method.description:
Returns the default value, if defined.
This method must continue to return the state variable default value after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.
method.return: The default value or {@code null} if not defined. The type of the returned object can be determined by {@code getJavaDataType}.

method.name: getAllowedValues
method.lead: Returns the allowed values, if defined.
method.description:
Returns the allowed values, if defined. Allowed values can be defined only for String types.
This method must continue to return the state variable allowed values after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.
method.return: The allowed values or {@code null} if not defined. Should be less than 32 characters.

method.name: getMinimum
method.lead: Returns the minimum value, if defined.
method.description:
Returns the minimum value, if defined. Minimum values can only be defined for numeric types.
This method must continue to return the state variable minimum value after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.
method.return: The minimum value or {@code null} if not defined.

method.name: getMaximum
method.lead: Returns the maximum value, if defined.
method.description:
Returns the maximum value, if defined. Maximum values can only be defined for numeric types.
This method must continue to return the state variable maximum value after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.
method.return: The maximum value or {@code null} if not defined.

method.name: getStep
method.lead: Returns the size of an increment operation, if defined.
method.description:
Returns the size of an increment operation, if defined. Step sizes can be defined only for numeric types.
This method must continue to return the step size after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.
method.return: The increment size or null if not defined.

method.name: sendsEvents
method.lead: Tells if this StateVariable can be used as an event source.
method.description:
Tells if this StateVariable can be used as an event source.
If the StateVariable is eventable, an event listener service can be registered to be notified when changes to the variable appear.
This method must continue to return the correct value after the UPnP state variable has been removed from the network.
method.return: {@code true} if the {@code StateVariable} generates events, {@code false} otherwise.

field.name: TYPE_UI1
field.lead: Unsigned 1 {@code Byte} int.
field.description:
Unsigned 1 {@code Byte} int.
Mapped to an {@code Integer} object.

field.name: TYPE_UI2
field.lead: Unsigned 2 Byte int.
field.description:
Unsigned 2 Byte int.
Mapped to {@code Integer} object.

field.name: TYPE_UI4
field.lead: Unsigned 4 Byte int.
field.description:
Unsigned 4 Byte int.
Mapped to {@code Long} object.

field.name: TYPE_I1
field.lead: 1 Byte int.
field.description:
1 Byte int.
Mapped to {@code Integer} object.

field.name: TYPE_I2
field.lead: 2 Byte int.
field.description:
2 Byte int.
Mapped to {@code Integer} object.

field.name: TYPE_I4
field.lead: 4 Byte int.
field.description:
4 Byte int.
Must be between -2147483648 and 2147483647
Mapped to {@code Integer} object.

field.name: TYPE_INT
field.lead: Integer number.
field.description:
Integer number.
Mapped to {@code Integer} object.

field.name: TYPE_R4
field.lead: 4 Byte float.
field.description:
4 Byte float.
Same format as float. Must be between 3.40282347E+38 to 1.17549435E-38.
Mapped to {@code Float} object.

field.name: TYPE_R8
field.lead: 8 Byte float.
field.description:
8 Byte float.
Same format as float. Must be between -1.79769313486232E308 and -4.94065645841247E-324 for negative values, and between 4.94065645841247E-324 and 1.79769313486232E308 for positive values, i.e., IEEE 64-bit (8-Byte) double.
Mapped to {@code Double} object.

field.name: TYPE_NUMBER
field.lead: Same as r8.
field.description:
Same as r8.
Mapped to {@code Double} object.

field.name: TYPE_FIXED_14_4
field.lead: Same as r8 but no more than 14 digits to the left of the decimal point and no more than 4 to the right.
field.description:
Same as r8 but no more than 14 digits to the left of the decimal point and no more than 4 to the right.
Mapped to {@code Double} object.

field.name: TYPE_FLOAT
field.lead: Floating-point number.
field.description:
Floating-point number.
Mantissa (left of the decimal) and/or exponent may have a leading sign. Mantissa and/or exponent may have leading zeros. Decimal character in mantissa is a period, i.e., whole digits in mantissa separated from fractional digits by period. Mantissa separated from exponent by E. (No currency symbol.) (No grouping of digits in the mantissa, e.g., no commas.)
Mapped to {@code Float} object.

field.name: TYPE_CHAR
field.lead: Unicode string.
field.description:
Unicode string.
One character long.
Mapped to {@code Character} object.

field.name: TYPE_STRING
field.lead: Unicode string.
field.description:
Unicode string.
No limit on length.
Mapped to {@code String} object.

field.name: TYPE_DATE
field.lead: A calendar date.
field.description:
A calendar date.
Date in a subset of ISO 8601 format without time data.
See http://www.w3.org/TR/ xmlschema-2/#date .
Mapped to {@code java.util.Date} object. Always 00:00 hours.

field.name: TYPE_DATETIME
field.lead: A specific instant of time.
field.description:
A specific instant of time.
Date in ISO 8601 format with optional time but no time zone.
See http://www.w3.org /TR/xmlschema-2/#dateTime .
Mapped to {@code java.util.Date} object using default time zone.

field.name: TYPE_DATETIME_TZ
field.lead: A specific instant of time.
field.description:
A specific instant of time.
Date in ISO 8601 format with optional time and optional time zone.
See http://www.w3.org /TR/xmlschema-2/#dateTime .
Mapped to {@code java.util.Date} object adjusted to default time zone.

field.name: TYPE_TIME
field.lead: An instant of time that recurs every day.
field.description:
An instant of time that recurs every day.
Time in a subset of ISO 8601 format with no date and no time zone.
See http://www.w3.org /TR/xmlschema-2/#time .
Mapped to {@code Long}. Converted to milliseconds since midnight.

field.name: TYPE_TIME_TZ
field.lead: An instant of time that recurs every day.
field.description:
An instant of time that recurs every day.
Time in a subset of ISO 8601 format with optional time zone but no date.
See http://www.w3.org /TR/xmlschema-2/#time .
Mapped to {@code Long} object. Converted to milliseconds since midnight and adjusted to default time zone, wrapping at 0 and 24*60*60*1000.

field.name: TYPE_BOOLEAN
field.lead: True or false.
field.description:
True or false.
Mapped to {@code Boolean} object.

field.name: TYPE_BIN_BASE64
field.lead: MIME-style Base64 encoded binary BLOB.
field.description:
MIME-style Base64 encoded binary BLOB.
Takes 3 Bytes, splits them into 4 parts, and maps each 6 bit piece to an octet. (3 octets are encoded as 4.) No limit on size.
Mapped to {@code byte[]} object. The Java byte array will hold the decoded content of the BLOB.

field.name: TYPE_BIN_HEX
field.lead: Hexadecimal digits representing octets.
field.description:
Hexadecimal digits representing octets.
Treats each nibble as a hex digit and encodes as a separate Byte. (1 octet is encoded as 2.) No limit on size.
Mapped to {@code byte[]} object. The Java byte array will hold the decoded content of the BLOB.

field.name: TYPE_URI
field.lead: Universal Resource Identifier.
field.description:
Universal Resource Identifier.
Mapped to {@code String} object.

field.name: TYPE_UUID
field.lead: Universally Unique ID.
field.description:
Universally Unique ID.
Hexadecimal digits representing octets. Optional embedded hyphens are ignored.
Mapped to {@code String} object.
